title: A Confession for the Autopsy
author: Sebastian Kavanagh
blurb: Wren Marchetti, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
